title: Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn’t Need Rate Cuts to Succeed
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn’t Need Rate Cuts to Succeed The USD lost 20% purchasing power in 5 years. Sam Callahan breaks down financial repression, core PCE spikes, and the U.S. bond market's historic drawdown. This post Sam Callahan: Bitcoin Doesn’t Need Rate Cuts to Succeed first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
